main_text.l: FLeƺe aures ad vota tuas, qua immurmuro
O Deus, o, genitor, clamores accipe raucos:
Accipe ab aurora lasi suspiria cordis,
Non etenim gaudes culpis nec crimine foedo:
Nec vultus speƫare tuos audebit iniquus:
Damnabis vanos, qui viuunt cade dolisque,
At bonitate tua fretus tua templa subibo,
Dux mihi sis, fulcru sœuus quado irruet hostis,
Sint blandi & triplices, vt hinc cu fermo sepulchru
Fac, rogo, labantur fraclis conatibus hostes,
Iusti ex opposito exiliat, sempérque triumphet,
Ipse etenim, iustis, qua iusta benignáq; reddes!

page.notes: Several words are doubtful because of ink fading and the scan: "immurmuro", "Sint" (possibly "Sunt"), "hinc cu" and "Vmbone" are read with [?]-level uncertainty. The long s in "si", "suspiria", "speƫare" and similar forms was printed as long s. The printed "speƫare" has a ligature-like form for "ct" which I read as "ct" and left unchanged. The Latin verse numbers are printed in the left margin. The Hebrew subtitle line is not printed on this page, only described by the phrase "xii. versibus Hebraeis". The first line of verse 1 has a large initial F. The catchword "PSAL-" is printed at the lower right.
